_note: CT Beef in the Debate Arena (unlock A6). Stake-free: nobody stakes Cash. The winner gets a house-paid reward (a faucet; Cash never moves between players), at most maxRewardedWinsPerDay per player and maxRewardedWinsPerPairPerDay per pair of players per UTC day, only for accounts at least minAccountAgeHours old. Elo moves for at most maxRatedMatchesPerPairPerDay matches between the same two players per UTC day (anti win-trading); a draw moves Elo as a draw and pays nothing. Phases: open (expires to expired) -> active (the debate) -> voting -> closed. At close an arena crowd of npcVotes is split by each participant's activity score during active (talk seconds x talkSecondWeight + emotes x emoteWeight + says x sayWeight, each talk span capped at maxTalkSpanSeconds, the score capped at maxScorePerParticipant); deterministic, no randomness. Player votes count 1 each. Voters: not a participant, not jailed, account at least minAccountAgeHours old, level (highest skill) at least minLevel.
